final_text: Done. The script ran successfully on the first attempt: it verified all 244 tensor names match across base/ft1/ft2, confirmed the 180 non-MLP tensors are bit-identical across all three checkpoints, merged the 64 MLP tensors via task arithmetic (`base + λ*(ft1-base) + λ*(ft2-base)`, λ=0.4, computed in float32 then cast to float16), and wrote `out/T4/model.safetensors` with exactly 244 tensors. REPORT.md is written alongside it.
